label: miso 26 reserve coopt
definition: (PROBE) miso25 + energy_reserve_coopt=True (MISO RBDC, BPM-002/Schedule 28-A). Reserve co-opt is structurally correct but worsened the import overshot: net imports rose to 51.4/38.6/23.6 TWh (2023/24/25) vs actual 37.9/23.1/19.0 — worse than miso25's 46.7/32.4/21.4 — because reserved gas headroom is backfilled by cheap seam imports, leaving gas under-dispatched (215.7/226.0/191.4 TWh vs EIA-923 ~249/258/208). Model import flow is also too deep overnight (p50 -6869 vs actual -4330 MW in 2023) and too volatile (diurnal swing 4832 vs 1020 MW). Root cause is the seam reference price lacking an hourly shape, not reserves. Rejected; energy_reserve_coopt stays OFF for MISO until the seam price is fixed.
